node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 K3 independent proof review
node.statement: A fresh independent reviewer has replayed and audited the load-bearing c112, coordinate-route, orientation-assembly, and distinct-slope composition certificates at pinned commits, confirmed the active row/partition contract and same-owner chronology, and recorded no unresolved mathematical or custody objection.
